# Proposed Change

## Related Issue

Link the Issue this Pull Request addresses.

Example: `Closes #12`

Small editorial corrections may be submitted directly without a prior Issue.

---

## RFC / Section

Identify the RFC and section affected by this change.

Example:

**RFC-0001 — Constraint 5: Exit**

---

## Proposed Change

Describe the change being made.

What text, definition, classification, example, structure, or supporting material is being changed?

---

## Reason for the Change

Explain why this change is necessary.

If this Pull Request resolves a counterexample or structural objection, explain how the proposed change resolves the identified problem.

---

## Effect on the Specification

Select all that apply:

- [ ] Editorial only — no structural effect
- [ ] Clarifies existing language
- [ ] Resolves an ambiguity
- [ ] Resolves a structural or logical objection
- [ ] Resolves a counterexample
- [ ] Changes classification behavior
- [ ] Changes or introduces a definition
- [ ] Changes or introduces a constraint
- [ ] Other

---

## Compatibility With the Invariant

For substantive changes, explain how the proposed change remains consistent with:

> **Voluntary Order Without Rulers**

For editorial-only changes, write `N/A`.

---

## Additional Context

Include any relevant Discussions, Issues, examples, references, or other information that may help evaluate the change.

---

## Submission Check

- [ ] I have reviewed the current version of the affected RFC.
- [ ] I have explained the purpose and effect of this change.
- [ ] I have linked the relevant Issue where one exists.
- [ ] This Pull Request is limited to the change described above.
